title: View and Manage AP/AR Data ON shows the same three tabs on a vendor
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Vendor and order management View and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open Vendors and open a vendor.
  2. Look at the tabs.
custom_expected: The Unpaid Invoices, Payments and Credits tabs are shown on the vendor page.
evidence: UI (Parts Manager, AP/AR ON): the vendor page (/parts/vendor/{id}) shows the AP/AR tabs — Contacts, Unpaid Invoices (30), Payments (4). screenshot vendordetail-vendON.
